observations: Blue game console wrapped in clear plastic film.
Gold/yellow PlayStation controller symbols (Triangle, Circle, Cross, Square) printed on the top surface.
Small white PlayStation logo in the top corner.
One DualShock 4 controller in a blue camouflage pattern.
The console has the thin, two-tier profile of a PS4 Slim.
Watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' appears on all photos.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Slim Days of Play Limited Edition

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show the blue 'Days of Play' limited edition console which has the slim form factor.
No game discs or digital library screens are shown in the photos.
PES 2027 does not exist (the series was rebranded to eFootball in 2021), and FIFA has been rebranded to FC.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and successfully loading a game disc.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or a dead battery.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu or a controller test screen.

risks.risk: The console might be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.
A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on, connected to a TV, and running a game.
Photo of the 'System Information' or 'Storage' screen in the settings menu.
Photos of the physical game discs or the digital library showing the 10 games.
Video demonstrating the controller working without stick drift.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a PS4 Slim Limited Edition. While the game claims are suspicious and functionality is unproven, it can be priced at the bottom of the PS4 market range as a worst-case scenario.
